F-03.evidence: Four continuity regressions failed before the correction and pass in the observed stabilization run, including preservation of old-method reports without replaying their omitted-gap interpretation.

F-04.change: The playbook, this record and PR description distinguish implemented automatic behavior, exact observed CI evidence, the unresolved shutdown diagnostic and outstanding installed-host/product qualifications.
